descriptor.scene: A small gathering of people is the subject: at dusk, SEVEN anonymous hopefuls of mixed ages sit and stand in a loose half-circle around the closed portal exactly as its locked closed plate paints it: a flat quiet ring of pale gold blossoms on the forest floor, moss and soft ferns grown back inside it, a few small flat unmarked stones at its edge. No portal light anywhere; the scene is lit by one hooded lantern set on the ground and the last blue-green dusk in the leaves. One elder hopeful stands mid-story with both arms spread wide and high, telling it BIGGER than the ring at his feet; the listeners' faces are warm, tired and rapt. Nothing ominous: a campfire-story mood, kind and a little wistful. The blossom ring sits right-of-center with the gathering wrapped around its left; the lower right corner above the caption card stays calm ground and lantern glow.
descriptor._caption: When a portal closes, it leaves a ring of pale gold flowers where the light once stood. The people who missed it gather there and tell stories about the ones who stepped through in time. The stories grow taller every season. That is how myths get written: by the people still on the ground.

prompt: Picture-book spread painted in the warm editorial ink-and-wash register of the FIRST reference image. THE FIRST REFERENCE IMAGE IS A STYLE ANCHOR ONLY. Match it for MEDIUM, BRUSHWORK, PALETTE and LIGHT QUALITY ONLY, and take NO subject from it whatsoever: none of its objects, figures, costume, props, furniture, architecture, period or location may appear in the output unless the scene description below asks for them by name. SCENE: A small gathering of people is the subject: at dusk, SEVEN anonymous hopefuls of mixed ages sit and stand in a loose half-circle around the closed portal exactly as its locked closed plate paints it: a flat quiet ring of pale gold blossoms on the forest floor, moss and soft ferns grown back inside it, a few small flat unmarked stones at its edge. No portal light anywhere; the scene is lit by one hooded lantern set on the ground and the last blue-green dusk in the leaves. One elder hopeful stands mid-story with both arms spread wide and high, telling it BIGGER than the ring at his feet; the listeners' faces are warm, tired and rapt. Nothing ominous: a campfire-story mood, kind and a little wistful. The blossom ring sits right-of-center with the gathering wrapped around its left; the lower right corner above the caption card stays calm ground and lantern glow. THE CAMERA MOVES; NOTHING ELSE DOES. Every person keeps the exact seat, side and place the setting's blocking gives them, and if a BLOCKING PLATE is supplied it is the authority on who sits where: obey it at every distance. Whatever the subject is sitting at, leaning on or standing beside is STILL IN THIS PICTURE, in the near foreground if the camera is close. Everyone else present in this place is STILL PRESENT in the picture, behind or beside the subject, soft and out of focus if they are not the subject, and NOBODY leaves and NO seat empties because the camera came closer. FRAMING, CLOSE-UP. IGNORE THE CAMERA DISTANCE IN THE SUPPLIED REFERENCE PLATE, and only the distance: in that plate the camera is far back, and HERE IT HAS WALKED IN CLOSE TO ONE PERSON WITHOUT ANYTHING ELSE CHANGING. ONE face fills the frame from the chest up and the head alone is at least a third of the frame height. If that person is seated at a table, THE NEAR EDGE OF THAT TABLE AND WHAT IS LAID ON IT RUNS ACROSS THE BOTTOM OF THE FRAME in front of them, because that is where they are sitting. What is behind them is what was actually behind them, closer now and thrown soft. the-portal exactly as its reference plate: A doorway of pure warm light hidden in the jungle: one upright pointed-oval of warm golden light, soft-edged like wet ink-wash with a thin brighter rim, its lower tip floating a hand's width above the forest floor. No frame, no ring, no arch, no standing stones, no machinery, no doorsill: the light alone is the door. Each era gets exactly one portal, and it shrinks: the more founders pass through and the longer it stands open, the smaller it gets, until it closes and leaves a flat ring of pale gold blossoms on the forest floor. Every portal in every era is this same design at some size. This era's portal at its opening is 3.8 m tall by 2.0 m wide: about twice a person's height, so a founder walks in without ducking and an adult's head reaches only halfway up the opening. Waning, the same shape shrinks to about 1.0 m, knee-to-waist high on an adult. Closed, a flat blossom ring about 2.0 m across lies on the forest floor. The lower tip always floats a hand's width (0.15 m) above the floor. The portal stands still; it never drifts, tilts or hovers higher. State-dependent only. Hidden: hanging vines, broad leaves and leaf-shadow curtain the light so only warm slivers show through; a passerby would walk within arm's length and never know. Master (found): the vines drawn aside, the oval open and generous, warm gold light with a few small drifting motes, soft warm glow on the nearest leaves. Waning: the same portal small and low, light gentler, the green closing in around it. Closed: no light at all, a quiet flat ring of pale gold blossoms in the green, moss and ferns grown back inside it. Nothing is ever scorched, broken or ominous. At its opening, about twice a person's height and wider than a garden gate; a closed ring reads about as wide as a person is tall lying down. In a wide shot the live portal is a tall warm almond of light against the green, unmistakably person-scaled, never building-scaled and never coin-scaled. THE ONLY PEOPLE IN THIS IMAGE ARE ANONYMOUS FIGURES THIS SCENE DESCRIBES: seven anonymous hopefuls of mixed ages, one elder mid-story with arms spread wide. They are ordinary unnamed people with no identity beyond what the scene says, and they are not any named character. NOBODY ELSE APPEARS. NEGATIVES: neon, 3D/CGI/Pixar, glossy plastic, HUD/arc-reactor comic vocabulary, neo-comic, a second portal, second oval of light or second blossom ring anywhere in the image, any portal light or glow from the blossom ring, ghost, spirit or supernatural glow above the ring. ONE SINGLE CONTINUOUS FULL-BLEED PAINTING that fills the entire canvas edge to edge. This is NEVER a grid, NEVER a multi-panel layout, NEVER a comic page, NEVER a contact sheet, NEVER a study or turnaround sheet, NEVER a collage, and NEVER several framed views side by side. Some reference images supplied to you are multi-panel study sheets; use them ONLY for the identity and design of what they depict, and NEVER copy their panelled layout into the output. The output has exactly ONE camera, ONE moment, and NO internal borders, frames, gutters, or dividing lines of any kind. DIRECTION OF TRAVEL. If a person in this scene is moving toward something, that destination MUST BE AHEAD OF THEM IN THE FRAME and they must be seen FROM BEHIND or from three-quarters behind, so the viewer is following them into it. A figure whose face is toward the camera is walking AWAY from everything behind them: if the thing they are moving toward is drawn behind them, the picture says the opposite of the scene. Their feet, hips, shoulders and gaze all point the same way, along the direction of travel.
